text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government will review increase in Gozo ferry fares. The new fares were announced by the government last week and have drawn a sharp reaction from businessmen, students and workers on the sister island of Gozo, three miles north of Malta.

- Opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami says new tax system will increase the cost of living. The system, which will replace VAT, includes 15 percent duty on imports, the same as VAT and an additional five per cent tax on products. But tax on services is being reduced.

- The General Workers Union said it accepts the composition of the new dockyard managing council, which has a majority of government representatives. The council running the state-owned, loss-making yard had previously been elected by the workers.
